# Describe: add expense
  /spreadsheets --add
    --document_id="13PVevQPgWe0HMt3DzV2ii5q4o1y2YQHHjen26PSVY-4"
    --expense_range="Лист1!G29:J110"
    --rest_balance_cell="Лист1!M7"

  # Context: with show rest balance
    /spreadsheets —add_expense
      --show_rest_balance
      —document_id="13PVevQPgWe0HMt3DzV2ii5q4o1y2YQHHjen26PSVY-4"
      —date="06.05.2026"
      —amount="100"
      —category="Продукты"

  # Context: without show rest balance
    /spreadsheets —add_expense
      —document_id="13PVevQPgWe0HMt3DzV2ii5q4o1y2YQHHjen26PSVY-4"
      —date="06.05.2026"
      —amount="100"
      —category="Продукты"

  /spreadsheets —list_all

  # Describe: saved inputs
    /spreadsheets —add_expense
      --show_rest_balance
      —document_id="13PVevQPgWe0HMt3DzV2ii5q4o1y2YQHHjen26PSVY-4"
      —date="06.05.2026"
      —amount="100"
      —category="Продукты"

    /spreadsheets —add_expense
      —amount="10"

# Curl variant
  # Describe: add expense
    # 1. Add spreadsheet
      curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/telegram/webhook \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d '{
          "message": {
            "message_id": 1,
            "text": "/spreadsheets --add --alias=\"тест-2\" --expense_range=\"Лист1!G29:J110\" --rest_balance_cell=\"Лист1!M7\"",
            "from": { "id": 111, "username": "test_user", "is_bot": false },
            "chat": { "id": 111, "type": "private" },
            "date": 1700000000
          }
        }'

    # Context: with show rest balance
        curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/telegram/webhook \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

            "message": {

              "from": { "id": 111, "username": "test_user", "is_bot": false },
              "chat": { "id": 111, "type": "private" },
              "date": 1700000001
            }
          }'

            "chat": { "id": 111, "type": "private" },
            "date": 1700000002
          }
        }'

    # 4. List all
      curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/telegram/webhook \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d '{
          "message": {
            "message_id": 4,
            "text": "/spreadsheets --list_all",
            "from": { "id": 111, "username": "test_user", "is_bot": false },
            "chat": { "id": 111, "type": "private" },
            "date": 1700000003
          }
        }'

    # Describe: saved inputs
